key_points: Alphabet disclosed AI-related issues, causing an ~4% intraday stock drop.
A securities fraud class-action lawsuit has been filed over the AI disclosures.
Gemini 4 launch and cloud AI spending are under scrutiny, with 82% cloud growth noted.
Alphabet is set to replace Verizon in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, a potential positive catalyst.
Mixed signals: cloud AI expansions (e.g., Applied Digital Finland campus) contrast with legal and execution concerns.
